parse_args: parse command line arguments for training with config file, split, iterations, and output directory
create_working_directory: create a timestamped working directory from args and config mapping for dataset experiments
create_logger: create a logger with both stream and file handlers writing to log.txt in the working directory
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to verify it correctly parses command line arguments
refactor_create_logger: refactor the create_logger function to support configurable log levels and additional handlers
